t:
No part of any appropriation contained in this title shall be used to pay the salary or wages of any person who engages in a linethrough against the Government of the United States or who is a member of an organization of Government employees that asserts the right to linethrough against the Government of the United States, or who advocates, or is a member of an organization that advocates, the overthrow of the Government of the United States by force or violence: 
Provided, That for the purposes hereof an affidavit shall be considered prima facie evidence that the person making the affidavit has not contrary to the provisions of this section engaged in a linethrough against the Government of the United States, is not a member of an organization of Government employees that asserts the right to linethrough against the Government of the United States, or that such person does not advocate, and is not a member of an organization that advocates, the overthrow of the Government of the United States by force or violence:

Provided further, That such administrative or supervisory employees of the Department as may be designated for the purpose by the Secretary are hereby authorized to administer the oaths to persons making affidavits required by this section, and they shall charge no fee for so doing:

Provided further, That any person who engages in a linethrough against the Government of the United States or who is a member of an organization of Government employees that asserts the right to linethrough against the Government of the United States, or who advocates, or who is a member of an organization that advocates, the overthrow of the Government of the United States by force or violence and accepts employment the salary or wages for which are paid from any appropriation contained in this title shall be guilty of a felony and, upon conviction, shall be fined not more than $1,000 or imprisoned for not more than one year, or both:

Provided further, That the above penalty clause shall be in addition to, and not in substitution for, any other provisions of existing law:

Provided further. That nothing in this section shall be construed to require an affidavit from any person employed for less than sixty days for sudden emergency work involving the loss of human life or destruction of property, and payment of salary or wages may be made to such persons from applicable appropriations for services rendered in such emergency without execution of the affidavit contemplated by this section.

fable.w: The tempting reading is that references to an "organization of Government employees" and affidavits suggest outside involvement in a federal process. That fails because the section only restricts the use of appropriations for salaries, sets an affidavit requirement for federal employment, and imposes criminal penalties. No outside party is consulted, heard, or given a right to challenge any federal decision, and there is no rulemaking, hearing, or advisory body.
fable.s: No part of any appropriation contained in this title shall be used to pay the salary or wages of any person who engages in a linethrough against the Government of the United States

qwen_block.w: This section establishes eligibility requirements for federal employment and criminal penalties for violating those requirements. It requires employees to submit affidavits regarding their political affiliations or activities, which is an internal administrative procedure for hiring and retention, not a mechanism for outside parties to participate in federal decision-making. There is no consultation with the public, states, or other external entities regarding policy decisions.
qwen_block.s: No part of any appropriation contained in this title shall be used to pay the salary or wages of any person who engages in a linethrough against the Government of the United States... Provided, That for the purposes hereof an affidavit shall be considered prima facie evidence that the person making the affidavit has not contrary to the provisions of this section engaged in a linethrough against the Government of the United States

opus.w: This is an appropriations limit. It bars paying salaries to people who strike against the government ("linethrough" appears to be a misprint for "strike") or who advocate its violent overthrow, and it adds a loyalty-affidavit requirement and a criminal penalty. Swearing an affidavit to qualify for pay is like applying for a benefit, not taking part in a federal decision. Mentioning employee organizations does not create any consultation, hearing, advisory body, or right to sue.
opus.s: Provided, That for the purposes hereof an affidavit shall be considered prima facie evidence that the person making the affidavit has not contrary to the provisions of this section engaged in a linethrough against the Government of the United States
opus.b: The tempting reading is that this is participation because the text mentions organizations of government employees (unions) and affidavits sworn before department officials. That reading fails. The affidavit is just a way for a person seeking federal pay to show they qualify, and the union is mentioned only as a reason to deny pay. No outside party is consulted on, or given a voice in, any federal decision.

qwen_chat.w: This section imposes conditions on federal employees regarding their loyalty and requires them to sign affidavits to receive salary. Federal employees are considered inside the federal government. The requirement to sign an affidavit is an internal administrative procedure for employment eligibility, not a mechanism for outside parties to participate in federal decision-making. There is no consultation with states, tribes, the public, or independent experts.
qwen_chat.s: No part of any appropriation contained in this title shall be used to pay the salary or wages of any person who engages in a linethrough against the Government of the United States... Provided, That for the purposes hereof an affidavit shall be considered prima facie evidence that the person making the affidavit has not contrary to the provisions of this section engaged in a linethrough against the Government of the United States
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that the requirement for employees to sign an affidavit constitutes "participation" because it involves an interaction between the individual and the government. However, this is an internal administrative requirement for federal employees (who are inside the government) to maintain their employment status. It does not involve consultation with outside parties, public comment, or advisory boards with non-federal members. The definition explicitly excludes interactions that stay within the federal government or are merely applications/conditions for benefits (like salary).
